requirement_text: Les etudiantes et etudiants titulaires d'un diplome etranger de fin d'etudes secondaires desireux de s'inscrire en 1re annee de licence doivent imperativement faire une Demande d'Admission Prealable (DAP) entre le 1er octobre 2025 et le 15 janvier 2026 delai de rigueur.
researcher_notes: Sorbonne Université is a standard French public university (unlike Sciences Po/Grande Ecole): admission is managed per-faculty (this record is Faculty of Sciences and Engineering specifically), and the applicable pathway depends on BOTH EU-citizenship status AND diploma type -- three combinations, not two: (1) non-EU + French Bac (current or forthcoming) -> Parcoursup; (2) non-EU + foreign diploma -> DAP (Demande d'Admission Prealable); (3) EU/Switzerland/Norway/Iceland/Liechtenstein, any diploma -> Parcoursup. Both other requirements/deadlines files reference this same fact per the brief's instruction that which pathway applies is itself the fact worth recording. This specific record covers the non-EU + foreign-diploma case (DAP route).

requirement_text: Les candidates et candidats residant a l'etranger, titulaires ou prochainement titulaires d'un baccalaureat francais (ou d'un titre francais admis en dispense du baccalaureat par une reglementation nationale ou du baccalaureat europeen) doivent se connecter sur le site Parcoursup entre le 19 janvier et le 12 mars 2026 inclus.

requirement_text: Un niveau B2 minimum en francais est indispensable pour candidater au niveau licence a la faculte des Sciences et Ingenierie de Sorbonne Universite. Vous devez etre en mesure de presenter un diplome ou une attestation reconnue par le ministere de l'Enseignement superieur francais certifiant de votre niveau (type TEF, TCF, DELF).
researcher_notes: Mandatory ('indispensable') for non-EU applicants specifically. Accepted proof: TEF, TCF, or DELF at B2. Genuinely scalar and unambiguous -- CEFRL B2 is a stable, unversioned scale, unlike the TOEFL rescale case documented elsewhere in this corpus.

requirement_text: Niveau de francais : un niveau B2 minimum en francais est fortement recommande pour candidater au niveau licence a la Faculte des Sciences et Ingenierie de Sorbonne Universite.
researcher_notes: Same B2 threshold as the non-EU record, but explicitly framed as 'strongly recommended' rather than mandatory for EU/EEA/Switzerland applicants -- a genuine difference in obligation strength between the two applicant categories on the same page, not a duplicate record.

requirement_text: For university-level courses in the Faculty of Arts & Humanities or the Faculty of Science & Engineering, the French fluency requirement is generally B2 or higher, based on the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL). Please note that at the Faculty of Medicine, the CEFRL C1 level in French is required for all degree programs.
researcher_notes: University-wide overview page; confirms B2 for Arts/Humanities and Science/Engineering (consistent with the faculty-specific page above) and a distinct, higher C1 threshold specifically for Medicine.
